note: Buy-side partial-fill remainder loop (#66) driven through the REAL DCABot.retryPartialFill — the SAME shared loop the buy path runs before crediting an exchange-cancelled partial buy. Synthetic names only; reproduces the shape of the real 'safety buy partially filled then cancelled' incident (an 89% fill, remainder cancelled) without any real coin. This grades the RETRY step of #66 (how much of the remainder completes). The crediting step itself, creditPartialBuyFill, recomputes the ladder through recalculateOrders (a DB write) and is covered separately by the trust-gate unit test.

scenarios.name: safety buy 89% then cancel — remainder completes on one retry, fully filled
safety buy 89% then cancel — remainder keeps getting cancelled, stays short (this is the case that then credits the actual fill and would otherwise strand coin)
safety buy remainder completes across two partial retries — every chunk accumulated
